title: Fibre Supply and Installation
summary: Fibre backbones, FTTH rollouts and inter site links. Splicing, OTDR testing and joint closures included.
highlights: Single mode and multi mode fibre supply
NLD backbones, FTTH and last mile builds
Fusion splicing with OTDR and OPM certification
FDP, FAT, ODF and joint closure installation
Aerial, duct and direct buried deployments
details: Our fibre crews handle everything from a single inter building run to long span NLD backbones. Every joint is tested and documented, every span comes with an OTDR trace, and our engineers have spent the last twenty five years putting fibre in the ground across Kerala.

title: Telecom Infrastructure Works
summary: The civil work behind every rollout. Manhole construction, pole erection, fencing, excavation, HDD and ROW liaison.
highlights: Horizontal Directional Drilling for trenchless crossings
Manual trenching for tight urban and congested routes
Manhole and chamber construction, pole erection, fencing
Right of Way liaison with NHAI, PWD and local bodies
BMBC and interlocking road restoration after the work is done
details: Telecom build out is half engineering and half paperwork. We run both. Our teams handle route surveys, ROW applications, civil work, restoration and handover documentation so the network owner is not chasing approvals while the project runs.

title: Structured Cabling Supply and Installation
summary: Cat6, Cat6A and Cat7 copper plus OM3 and OM4 fibre, designed and installed to standards your IT team can sign off on.
highlights: Cat6, Cat6A and Cat7 horizontal cabling
OM3 and OM4 multi mode fibre backbones
Patch panels, ODFs and full rack build outs
Fluke channel and permanent link certification
Aerial and inter building runs for multi block campuses
details: Structured cabling is the part of the network nobody sees until it fails. We design, install, label and certify every run, so audits are simple and adds and moves are predictable. From a single floor fitout to a multi building campus, the work is documented and certified before we hand over.

title: Security System Projects
summary: CCTV, access control and intrusion systems for offices, campuses, industrial sites and high security areas.
highlights: IP and analogue CCTV with NVR and VMS integration
Access control with card, biometric and mobile credentials
Perimeter, indoor and PTZ camera coverage design
PoE switching and structured backbone for camera networks
Annual maintenance and remote health monitoring
details: We design CCTV and access control as part of the broader network, not bolted on afterwards. The cameras, the switches and the controllers all sit on infrastructure we install ourselves, which keeps the system predictable and the maintenance straightforward.

title: IT Hardware Supply and Support
summary: Servers, switches, firewalls, workstations and the wiring that ties them together. Sourced, installed and supported under one contract.
highlights: Tier one OEM sourcing with warranty registration on every unit
Servers, storage, switches, routers, firewalls and Wi-Fi
Laptops, desktops and workstations for office fitouts
Asset tagging, configuration and on site delivery
Annual rate contracts for enterprises and large projects
details: We supply and install IT hardware for corporate offices, campuses and industrial sites across India. Long standing OEM relationships mean honest pricing and quick lead times, and our engineers handle racking, configuration and warranty paperwork so your IT team stays focused on users instead of logistics.
